summary: Frontend-only verification of Leaflet + OpenStreetMap maps migration (replacing Google Maps). All 5 required scenarios pass on the live preview URL. Paris and Toulouse city hub pages render an embedded Leaflet map (data-testid=city-map) with OSM tiles (6-8 tiles loaded) and 'OpenStreetMap' attribution — no Google Maps billing error overlay. Logged in as admin qa+1790066392@rantau.test and created event 'QA Maps Event 1791041986' at '12 Rue Alsace-Lorraine, Toulouse, France'; OSM Nominatim geocode succeeded and app redirected to /events/<id>. Event detail page shows the embedded Leaflet map (data-testid=event-map) with a visible, non-broken marker (img.leaflet-marker-icon naturalWidth=25, served as a webpack-bundled base64 PNG — the L.Icon.Default.mergeOptions fix works). The 'Open in Google Maps' fallback link (data-testid=event-maps-link) is also present. No Leaflet, marker-icon, or react-leaflet console errors detected. Only noise = pre-existing transient Firestore WebChannel 'unavailable' warnings (same as iteration_2, unrelated).
critical_code_review_comments: MapView.jsx correctly deletes L.Icon.Default.prototype._getIconUrl and merges imported marker PNG assets so webpack-hashed URLs are used — marker renders as embedded data: URL (naturalWidth=25). Clean.

geocode() uses Nominatim with no User-Agent / Referer identification. Nominatim ToS asks for a descriptive User-Agent; fetch() in browser can't override User-Agent but adding an 'Accept-Language' and keeping volume low is recommended. For heavy use, add client-side debounce or move to backend proxy with proper UA.
EventDetail.jsx:124 renders the Google Maps fallback link always (good), independent of whether coords exist — matches spec.
seed_data_creation: Created one event via live Firestore: 'QA Maps Event 1791041986' at /events/<id> (Toulouse, 12 Rue Alsace-Lorraine, 2026-06-15 19:00) owned by admin. Has lat/lng from Nominatim.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Maps migration verified working on Paris/Toulouse hubs and on event detail. OSM tiles come from {s}.tile.openstreetmap.org; the marker icon loads as a data: URL embedded by webpack (not a .png file request), so there is no network 404 for marker-icon.png. Allow ~3-4s after locating [data-testid=city-map]/[data-testid=event-map] for tiles to populate before asserting img.leaflet-tile count. Firestore WebChannel 'unavailable' warnings on first navigation are transient and unrelated.
